toolKinds.panel: Docked persistent or collapsible panel attached to a side/bottom dock.
toolKinds.floatingPanel: Free-floating window that can be repositioned and optionally redocked.
toolKinds.palette: Compact source/brush/object selector that feeds the active canvas document.
toolKinds.timeline: Time-based editor strip, usually docked bottom or floating.
toolKinds.browser: Project resource tree or searchable resource browser.
toolKinds.modal: Short-lived blocking dialog only for confirmation, naming, or destructive operations; not for normal editing.

requiredInputRules: top-level menu, document tabs, and canvas/workspace tabs always route before tool-panel content
tool panels may own drag gestures only after the initial press starts inside the panel
Esc closes the focused floating panel or modal; it must not lock the editor into a panel
panel hotkeys route through the command registry so shortcuts remain visible and configurable
genericizationRequirement: Every editor tool must be registerable without referencing Havenwild by name. Havenwild adds project-specific panels or vocabulary through HavenwildProjectProfile.
